[[File:Sun_skimmer_2000_sun_jammer.jpg|thumb|A Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer]]
'''Sun jammers''' were a type of [[Star/Legends|solar]] wind-driven recreational vehicle/racing ship. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] a sun jammer was known as "sun jamming." Popular [[sun jammer racing]] events included the [[Chandrilan Cometary Games]].

Annual sun-jammer races were sponsored by the [[Kendamari Casinos]] in the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]], attracting [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] from neighboring [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] to their casinos.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>

A popular model was the [[Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer]].
